local_reimplementations.name: AppBreadcrumb
local_reimplementations.notes: Clean wrapper over Nuxt UI's UBreadcrumb that auto-prepends a 'Home' crumb -- functionally the same job as narduk-core's AppBreadcrumbs, but this app is on the legacy template layer (no narduk-core dependency), so it cannot consume the shared one yet. Straightforward migration candidate once/if this app moves off the legacy layer.

local_reimplementations.name: Auth* component family (AuthLoginCard, AuthRegisterCard, AuthExchangePanel, AuthLoginFormSection, AuthRegisterFormSection)
local_reimplementations.duplicates_lib: AuthLoginCard | AuthRegisterCard | AuthExchangePanel (all three are literal name-for-name matches with narduk-auth's shipped components)
local_reimplementations.notes: DEAD CODE: grep -rn for each of these five component names across apps/web/app returns zero hits anywhere outside their own files (and AuthLoginFormSection/AuthRegisterFormSection are only referenced from their own dead parent cards). There is no pages/login.vue or pages/register.vue in this app at all (pages are: index, about, admin/index, admin/observations/[id], bluebonnets/index, bluebonnets/[city]/index, bluebonnets/[city]/map). knip.json treats 'app/components/**/*.vue' as an entry point (Nuxt auto-import convention), so knip's own unused-file detection will NOT flag this -- it is invisible to the repo's own tooling. Names match narduk-auth's AuthLoginCard/AuthRegisterCard/AuthExchangePanel exactly, strongly suggesting this app pre-dates narduk-auth's extraction and simply never got auth wired up or migrated. Do not count this toward 'apps actively hand-roll auth N times' without this caveat.

top_extraction_candidates.name: CollectionTable (admin server-paginated)
top_extraction_candidates.why: The single richest, most complete table example across all four L2 repos: server search+offset/limit paging, zod-validated query params, row link, actions column, loading/error/empty states, edit modal. Its main gap -- a 'sortable: true' column flag with no wired v-model:sorting -- is exactly the kind of half-finished sort affordance a shared component should either fully support or omit.

top_extraction_candidates.name: Delete or migrate dead Auth* component family
top_extraction_candidates.why: 637 loc of fully dead code (0 consumers, no login/register pages exist) that exactly duplicates narduk-auth's shipped AuthLoginCard/AuthRegisterCard/AuthExchangePanel by name -- invisible to knip because components are treated as entry points. Worth flagging to Logan directly regardless of the table-library project.

top_extraction_candidates.name: AppBreadcrumb -> AppBreadcrumbs migration
top_extraction_candidates.why: Clean 1:1 functional match (UBreadcrumb wrapper with Home-prepend) blocked only by this app still being on the legacy template layer rather than narduk-core.

notes: Richest and largest app in this lane (36 vue files vs 16-18 for the others), and the only one with real server-paginated admin tables. legacy_template_layer=true (depends on narduk-nuxt-template-layer-analytics/core/maps/seo/testing/uploads, NOT the newer narduk-core/seo/analytics packages) -- yet it still gets AppMapKit (narduk-mapkit-nuxt, 3 uses) and AppTabs (narduk-core, 2 uses) via those layers, so the legacy/current split isn't a clean line. Two separate dead-code pockets found (Auth* family, 637 loc; FilterBar.vue + SightingCard.vue, 125 loc) that knip's own config would not catch since it treats all app/components/**/*.vue files as entry points -- flagged in local_reimplementations rather than silently counted as 'active hand-rolled patterns'. Real mobile-specific regression history exists (PRs #61-64) unlike the other three L2 repos, which had none.
